name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v1867: His live journal holds 1729 rows written by a test harness, three quarters of every session_end row in it, still arriving during tonight gate runs. The harness isolates its frames and its hist root correctly and never knew there was a third path, so close_session appended into his real journal. Fixed at the module rather than the call site: an overridden hist that does not live under tv now implies an overridden journal, so the next harness that forgets is protected too. Proven by running the suite twice with the count unchanged.
